title: Brilliant experience!
text: It was an amazing experience! Pier was such an attentive guide and took a genuine interest in us and our lives. He also showed compassion when my daughter took a tiny tumble and while we were learning the ropes. Overall, this was an amazing experience and would highly recommend to anyone thinking of taking part. Big thank you to Pier for being the most amazing tour guide.

title: Segway’in Barcelona
text: This tour on a Segway is amazing. I was blessed with two fantastic guides in Maria and Giovanni; they are the best. A must tour if you are visiting Barcelona
author: David_C

title: Amazing
text:
The tour was brilliant

author: homak501

title: Great fun ... ask for Fabio!
text: We had such a fabulous time on the 3-hour Montjuic segway tour at 1600. Our guide, Fabio, was excellent. He was thorough with the set-up and gave clear instruction. His knowledge was fantastic, which he imparted in very good English and with a great sense of humour. Great fun, and I'd thoroughly recommend it.
author: Laura C

title: Beautiful Barcelona
text: Steve did a wonderful job of taking us to the sights we wanted to see and giving us great information. We had two first time Segway riders with us and they loved it. I highly recommend a Segway to zip through Barcelona.
author: Debbie G

title: Super pleasant
text: A super friendly guide who knows everything about the city and its history! To do and redo! The Segways are in good condition, unlike other experiences elsewhere in the world
